findings.screen: Source: ios/Shared/ReminderAttributes.swift lines(from:), surfaceLines(_:limit:), capped(_:limit:); ios/Shared/LockScreenLineBudget.swift ReminderActivityLinesView
findings.evidence: Production lines(from:) first caps flattened reminder lines and can insert +N more. ReminderActivityLinesView later calls surfaceLines, which caps that array again and counts the prior summary as one line. Example: five visible lines plus +5 more, capped to four rows, yields three visible lines plus +3 more although seven original lines are hidden. Multiline reminders can reach this path within the board’s reminder-count limit. Native Activity fixtures inject eight raw lines directly, so their correct +5/+6 footers do not cover this case.
findings.fix: Preserve the total hidden-line count as structured presentation data through payload and surface caps, or otherwise make repeated capping account for an existing summary without treating user text as metadata. Keep the exact +N more wording and all visible reminder text unchanged.
findings.basis: source-derived conditional defect; not observed in the eight-raw-line capture fixture; no new test executed by reviewer
findings.check: Add a production-pipeline regression using multiline Reminder values: after payload cap and smaller island/lock-screen cap, assert displayed original lines plus hidden count equals total flattened originals. Include the five-visible-plus-five-hidden then limit-four example expecting +7 more. Keep payload <=4096 bytes, Unicode cases, native footer geometry and existing 261-test suite.

findings.evidence: Invalid frame dimension (negative or non-finite) recurred once in testFocusedEmailAndPasswordClearKeyboardInBothAppearances. The test passed; the warning is unresolved and is separate from assertion results. No captured still proves a negative-frame visual failure, and the precise originating view is not isolated.
findings.fix: Isolate the warning during keyboard show/focus scrolling and correct the non-finite/negative layout proposal at its source without suppressing the diagnostic or changing any copy. Keep the actual field/keyboard and action separation checks.
findings.confidence: high for warning occurrence; medium for user-visible impact
findings.basis: observed structured runtime diagnostic; causal attribution unconfirmed
findings.check: Run the complete sign-in default/XXXL, light/dark email/password keyboard matrix with runtime issue collection and require zero invalid-frame diagnostics alongside all geometry assertions. Repeat transitions enough to reproduce the prior warning and record command/source SHA. Run existing suite.

findings.screen: Source: SignInView.swift auth.notice observer; ReminderListView.swift presentError/BoardErrorBanner; AccountView.swift error section
findings.evidence: Success/inbox and reminder completion explicitly post announcements; new auth and board/account errors rely on updatesFrequently traits and haptics. That is insufficient evidence that a user whose VoiceOver focus remains in an input hears the new failure. No VoiceOver session was supplied, so missed announcement is a risk, not an observed accessibility failure.
findings.fix: Use a deliberate announcement or accessible focus policy for newly presented errors while retaining existing error wording and avoiding duplicate announcements. Keep the user’s editing context when recovery is local.
findings.check: With VoiceOver enabled, trigger first-load, populated-board, auth and account errors from a controlled offline fixture. Require the existing error text to be announced once and recovery control reachable in a predictable order; verify focus after retry, list reload and sheet dismissal. Run existing suite.
